question: When he sees Julius getting along well with Subaru, how does he react?
answer: There's no scenes where Subaru and Julius are getting along well, so that's a difficult question, indeed. It might not be fair to answer a different one, but when Joshua is able to get his hair all together nicely on the first try, he jinxes himself by believing that means it will be a good day. Well, that one day in Priestella should have ended up well, it's true!
